title: Universal Newsreel outtake: 1936 US Olympic basketball trial, Universal Pictures team vs Arkansas
contents: Full-court action from the 1936 trials. The Universal Pictures team went on to form the core of the gold-medal US team at the first Olympic basketball tournament (Berlin 1936).
license: Universal donated its newsreel library to the US National Archives without copyright restrictions, but NARA marks items 'Restricted – Possibly' (third-party content), so the risk is low but not zero. Korea PD (1936).
